keep: Clean crisp frames that show only this creature; the transparent background stays empty. Colors, brightness, material finish and lighting stay exactly as in the still in every frame. Existing colored markings remain steady and the same size. The creature keeps its original body proportions and full silhouette inside the canvas. Keep exactly four hooved legs, one dragon head, two antlers and one tail. Antler shapes, blue markings and metal bands stay attached and unchanged.

clips.idle: Gentle breathing in place: neck flexes subtly and tail moves slightly while hooves remain planted.
clips.walk: Walks in place on four hooved legs with a measured alternating gait and a steady neck.
clips.attack: Lowers its neck, thrusts its antlers forward once in the first half, then raises its head back to the original pose.
clips.hurt: Jerks its neck back slightly and bends its hooved legs, then steadies.
clips.death: Four legs fold beneath it, its neck lowers and the whole body settles onto its side, ending lying still with antlers intact.
